title: Integreat
description: Integrates mods together to provide even more functionality. Essentially an addon for multiple mods. Its cool and incentivizes players to interact with more than just 1 mod at a time.
body:
Integrates mods together to provide even more functionality. Essentially an addon for multiple mods. Its cool and incentivizes players to interact with more than just 1 mod at a time.

Items:
- A currently unobtainable item.
- And 3 semi-finalized (the textures are silly) items. The Nymph Bottles! (1 shown below) A strong source of potion effects. Throw them in lava/fire or use them in the nether for a neat surprise.

![A showcase of the pink nymph bottle used for defense. Look at its cute face,,,,](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7aa0a6babd697bd484a6cb41c9a162c969cccda4.gif)

Future:
- Replace nymph bottle spawning with custom demon entity and boss (boss for green/sad nymph bottle). They will drop demon scales; a crafting material.
- Crush prismatic jewels (Terramity) and mix them with fairy dust and sponge to make an item required to apply magic to items automatically.


Dependancies:
- [Destroy](https://modrinth.com/mod/destroy)
- [Terramity](https://modrinth.com/mod/terramity)
- [Alex's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-mobs)
- ...and all of their dependancies also ;)
